verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The added feature-matrix leg enables the default-off `odrl-authz` feature, matching the integration test's file-level cfg and making that suite executable. The golden leg-name update is consistent. The coverage-presence check reports 1014 tests for `sparq-lws-core`, so the raised floor of 1000 is valid. The release documentation remains consistent with the checked-in LWS container workflow's tag/dispatch triggers, native smoke and scan stages, multi-architecture publish, image tags, SBOM, and provenance configuration. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue is evident. Progress is stagnant because the prior round also had no findings and the reviewed diff is materially unchanged.
